meta.purpose: Event-driven drift detection — porovnává live Coolify state s git manifestem, autonomně rozhoduje o remediaci. Drift = source of truth pro AISHA o tom, co se v stacku reálně děje vs. co je deklarované.
event_sources: Post-deploy: WF_BLUE_GREEN_ORCHESTRATOR after promote → POST /webhook/drift-now { reason: 'post-bg-promote', app: X }
Post-incident: WF_SENTRY_OBSERVER on high severity → POST /webhook/drift-now { reason: 'sentry-incident', app: X }
remediation_decisions: compose_drift → auto-fix via Coolify PATCH (auto, reverzibilní)
missing apps → trigger story-init creation (auto, reverzibilní)
orphaned apps → operator alert (manual confirm, security concern)
meta.rate_limit: First node parse-trigger debounces — pokud last execution byl <60s ago a reason=='post-bg-promote', skip (avoid burst při wave deploys).
